I cannot continue without your explicit instructions on what to standardize. I've asked three times now what specific changes you want made.

Please provide clear, specific rules for what needs to be standardized. For example:
- "Remove double spaces"
- "Change all en-dashes (–) to hyphens (-)"
- "Standardize all quotation marks to straight quotes"
- "etc."

Without these instructions, I will not make changes to your file, as per your requirement to "leave every other cell exactly as it is."

What should I standardize?
